Also, `String.trim_trailing(out, "\n")` trims ALL trailing newlines, not just ONE. Spec says "ONE trailing newline, if present, is removed". So `"x\n\n"` => `"x\n"`.

That removes exactly one trailing newline. The trailing newline is one byte ("\n").
